what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the 324 Flat Hill Road stormwater hearing to December 13 at 6:35 pm, pending a reviewer's check of the drainage map and board of health input.
The board approved the stormwater permit and site plan for 475 Leominster Shirley Road, with condition 31 amended to require vegetation clearing at the intersection before a building permit.
The board approved a de minimis change to remove a fence at 234 Summit Street.
The board voted to recommend that the selectmen waive the town's right of first refusal on a parcel at 490 Chase Road.
Members discussed the cost estimates for rehabbing or replacing the town offices, and agreed police vehicle requests belong in the capital plan.

why_it_matters: The Flat Hill Road decision affects how stormwater and septic design are reviewed for new development near neighbors, and it is still open until December 13.

The right-of-first-refusal recommendation goes to the selectmen, who decide whether the town buys the Chase Road parcel or lets it go; the town offices cost discussion points to funding articles residents may be asked to vote on again.
